title: CubeOS Coreapps — Docker Swarm stack orchestrator
build_command: echo 'no build — compose files are the artefact'

parent_project.note: Track A of CubeOS — the bundled docker-compose / Swarm stacks. Pulled from registry, deployed by releases firstboot, consumed by hal + api.

_bounded_contexts_note: Each entry maps 1:1 to a top-level subdir under coreapps/ (each containing appconfig/docker-compose.yml).
security_posture: LAN-only inside CubeOS box; compose files reference localhost:5000 ONLY (parent Article XIV); watchdog enforces health + restart per Article C-IV below; no direct internet exposure (each coreapp exposes via its own port + npm reverse proxy)
_surfaces_note: Coreapps is a config + orchestration repo — no HTTP API of its own (each coreapp's compose file exposes its service's port). No event bus. Persistent volumes mounted into coreapps live OUTSIDE this repo at /cubeos/data/.
